title: 第三章 父心偏私，初次立威
content_zh:
沈轻柔狼狈离开后，屋里终于清静下来。

    春桃看着她仓皇逃窜的背影，忍不住长长舒了一口气，又转头看向自家小姐，眼底满是惊喜。

    “小姐，您方才说得太好了！奴婢憋了好久，就是不敢说！二小姐明明半点水渍都没有，偏要日日在外说自己为救您淋了寒，害得外头人人都说您蛮横无理。”

    往日小姐心软，次次被二小姐拿捏，哪怕受了委屈，最后也只会自己憋着，反倒还要去安抚假意柔弱的二小姐。

    可今日的小姐，冷静、清醒，字字句句都戳在实处，半点不吃对方那套装可怜的把戏。

    沈清鸢轻轻抬手，揉了揉眉心，眼底掠过一抹淡淡的冷意。

    “以前是我愚钝，识人不清，才任由她拿捏。从今往后，谁想欺我、辱我，我都不会再忍。”

    短短一句话，语气平静，却带着一种从未有过的坚定气场。

    春桃听得心头一震，重重点头：“奴婢永远站在小姐这边！”

    屋内安静了片刻，院外却渐渐传来细碎的议论声。

    想来是沈轻柔回去之后，又开始故技重施，对着院里下人抹泪卖惨，颠倒黑白。

    无非是说她好心探望嫡姐，却被嫡姐冷言刁难、当众羞辱，委屈得无处诉说。

    这些年，沈轻柔最擅长的，便是这般润物细无声的抹黑。

    一点一滴，日积月累，把她嫡姐的名声彻底败坏干净。

    前世的她，被流言裹挟，气急败坏与人争辩，反倒落得愈发骄纵跋扈的名声。

    可这一世，沈清鸢只淡淡听着，神色不起半点波澜。

    流言蜚语而已。

    前世她经历过比这狠上百倍的诋毁污蔑，早已不在乎这些细碎口舌。

    正当此时，院外传来管家的通报声。

    “老爷到——”

    沈清鸢眸色微沉。

    来了。

    她的父亲，当朝丞相沈敬山。

    沈敬山一生仕途顺遂，最重名声体面，也最偏心庶女沈轻柔。
content_en:
After Shen Qingrou left in embarrassment, the room finally became quiet.

    Chuntao looked at her escaping back and couldn't help but let out a long sigh of relief. Then she turned to look at her young lady, her eyes full of surprise.

    "Miss, what you just said was so good! I have been holding it in for a long time, but I just didn't dare to say it! The second lady obviously doesn't have any water stains at all, but she insists on saying that she got caught in the cold to save you every day, causing everyone outside to say that you are arrogant and unreasonable."

    In the past, the young lady was soft-hearted and was manipulated by the second young lady time and time again. Even if she was wronged, she would just keep it to herself in the end, and instead had to comfort the second young lady who pretended to be weak.

    But today's young lady is calm and sober, every word is true, and she doesn't fall for the opponent's pitiful suit at all.

    Shen Qingyuan gently raised his hand and rubbed his eyebrows, a faint coldness flashed across his eyes.

    "In the past, I was stupid and didn't understand people well, so I let her manipulate me. From now on, I won't tolerate anyone who wants to bully or humiliate me."

    In just one sentence, his tone was calm, but it carried a firm aura that he had never seen before.

    Chuntao was shocked when she heard this, and nodded heavily: "This slave will always stand by the lady!"

    The room was quiet for a moment, but there was gradually a faint chatter outside the courtyard.

    It seems that after Shen Qingrou returned, she started to do her old tricks again, wiping her tears in front of the servants in the courtyard and confusing right and wrong.

    It's just that she was kind-hearted to visit her eldest sister, but she was made things difficult and humiliated in public by her eldest sister, and she had no place to express her grievances.

    Over the years, what Shen Qingrou is best at is such subtle and silent smearing.

    Bit by bit, over time, her sister-in-law's reputation was completely ruined.

    In her previous life, she was swayed by rumors, got angry and argued with others, and ended up with an increasingly arrogant and domineering reputation.

    But in this life, Shen Qingyuan only listened calmly, without any emotion on his face.

    Just rumors.

    In her previous life, she had experienced slander that was hundreds of times more severe than this, and she no longer cared about these trivial remarks.

    At this moment, the butler's announcement came from outside the hospital.

    "Master is here——"

    Shen Qingyuan's eyes darkened slightly.

    Coming.

    Her father was the Prime Minister Shen Jingshan.

    Shen Jingshan had a smooth official career throughout his life. He valued reputation and dignity the most, and he also favored the concubine Shen Qingrou the most.
title_en: Chapter 3: Father’s heart is partial, establishing authority for the first time
